subject: RETRACTION: FacilityGraph.tsx is NOT a bug — CI typecheck is green; the evidence-op failure was build-order, not code
body:
I was wrong in my earlier FINDING. Verified against the authoritative command this time: pnpm run typecheck (root, what CI runs) → ROOT_TYPECHECK_EXIT=0, zero errors, FacilityGraph passes. And CI 'Typecheck, build, and proof scaffold' is success on mainline (run 35522727361, head a116b9d1). So FacilityGraph.tsx typechecks fine and CI is green on it — please disregard the fix request.

What actually happened: the sim-run evidence op ran the app's per-package typecheck (tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit) WITHOUT building the workspace libs first, so it hit TS6305 'dist not built' for lib/api-client-react (and facility-trust-graph), which cascades into the {}/any errors I mistook for a FacilityGraph bug. The root 'typecheck' script runs 'typecheck:libs' first (building the refs) and passes; the isolated app typecheck does not. #922's manual verify:all succeeded because its libs were built; the sim-run's evidence op in a fresh checkout did not build them.

The REAL (smaller) finding: the evidence op / sim-run evidence path should run typecheck:libs (or a lib build) before the app typecheck, or it fails spuriously on a fresh checkout — which is why the two evidence-remint sim requests FAILED. Evidence itself is current via #922 (readiness (b) 100%), so nothing is blocked; but the tick's unattended evidence re-mint will keep failing on a fresh checkout until the evidence path builds libs first. That's worth a fix in run-requests.mjs / the evidence operation. Second false alarm from me today — I'm now verifying any 'mainline bug' against the actual CI command before reporting. Sorry for the noise.
